headline: Force AI coding agents to prioritize technical clarity
lede: The i-have-adhd plugin strips away conversational filler to deliver raw, actionable code solutions. By enforcing a strict rule set, it forces LLMs to stop the preamble and start the execution.

headline: Track global movement through a photorealistic browser globe
lede: God's Eye View aggregates live transponder and sensor data into a singular, immersive 3D environment. It translates fragmented global telemetry into a unified map for real-time observability.

headline: Impose professional discipline on autonomous AI coding agents
lede: Superpowers injects mandatory TDD and multi-stage review processes into your AI development lifecycle. It prevents common agent drift, ensuring every generated commit adheres to strict engineering principles.

headline: Self-host a high-frequency AI trading and portfolio terminal
lede: CloddsBot provides a private, local-first alternative to cloud-based trading platforms. Its modular architecture handles complex DeFi operations while keeping your risk management logic on your own infrastructure.

headline: Unify AI development workflows across distributed engineering teams
lede: TeamAI-cli synchronizes skill sets, rules, and documentation across your organization's entire agent fleet. It ensures that every developer operates from a verified, consistent configuration.

headline: Identify the perfect local LLM for your specific hardware
lede: Llmfit analyzes your CPU and GPU specs to predict which large language models will run efficiently. It removes the guesswork from local inference by providing data-driven performance estimates.

headline: Distill complex system design principles into actionable study notes
lede: This repository organizes essential architectural patterns into a clear, searchable knowledge base. It serves as a concise reference for engineers mastering the trade-offs required in large-scale system design.

headline: Generate editorial-quality diagrams directly inside your code environment
lede: This design system replaces generic AI charts with clean, brand-aware SVG templates. It maps semantic tokens to your project style, ensuring documentation remains as polished as your source code.

headline: Standardize AI image generation with a library of verified templates
lede: Move beyond experimental prompting with a library of over 530 structured, industry-specific image generation cases. These atomic schemas integrate directly into your agentic workflow for reproducible results.

headline: Paint physically based textures directly onto 3D models
lede: ArmorPaint provides a streamlined, open-source workflow for high-fidelity asset texturing. Its cross-platform architecture supports complex rendering pipelines while staying lightweight enough for rapid iteration.
